messages.author: Debarati DasGupta
messages.body:
Hi All
I have been doing some clustering on my protein trajectories and I have a dbscan output here. What I don�t understand is the sum of Frac column should that not add up to 1?
[cid:image001.png.01D6009E.6F0AA650]
I added up the numbers under Frac header and I got 0.615!
What happens to the remainder of the frames then??
I m missing out on something?
Regards

messages.author: Elvis Martis
messages.body:
Hello
To the best of my knowledge, if you are using sieve, there are many frames
which are discarded as noise, and hence, not a part of any cluster. So
total frames and fraction in each cluster will never equal the total input
frames and fraction won't be 1.
I hope it helps.
Best Regards
